corpora.basis: All 54,853 snapshot rows have year=2024 and source URLs in the official GovInfo USCODE-2024 collection. GovInfo's content metadata for that edition states 'Laws In Effect As Of Date: January 6, 2025'. This corpus evidence, not the dataset repository's 2026-08-26 commit date, establishes the cutoff. The aligned OLRC USLM release point is Public Law 118-274 dated 2025-01-06, except 118-159; M0.5B1 must retain that exception when scoring textual alignment.

No global legal-content cutoff can be established from this mixed corpus. Its 220,018 CFR rows carry source years 2024 (511), 2025 (6,153), and 2026 (213,354) and use moving /current/ eCFR URLs; its 362,036 Federal Register rows carry publication years 1994-2026. A row year is not a legal-content cutoff. The 2026-08-26 repository commit date is publication metadata and is not used as a cutoff. CFR-A1 must compare the CFR subset with the point-in-time eCFR candidate and report residual skew separately; Federal Register rows remain non-composable historical documents.
